notes: Real FW13.52 profile promoted from W9 live attestation evidence (2026-10-05) plus the pinned FW13.52 research. Identity basis: seven STRICT_FINGERPRINT windows of the kernel image matched the live kernel byte for byte (host-verified), so the firmware family 13.52 is derived from kernel evidence and NOT from the userland kern.sdk_version value. No runtime address (LSTAR, kbase, KASLR slide, aperture value) is stored here: those live in runtime evidence and runtime bindings only. aperture_global is STRUCTURAL_ONLY by agreement and is never part of the identity. Console identity from the capture dossier (/home/hermes/audits/playstation-ps4/fw1352-ps4b-20260920/README.md, sha256 9563bc80304707310027a0c6d64351d7dfab16e08e526e27e98270265402cc39). SCOPE: this profile evidences the kernel attestation windows only. Gated operations whose locator is not evidenced here carry profile_required=true with locator_ref=null (explicitly pending) and refuse with LOCATOR_MISSING; the binding authority for them stays the W4 requirement table, and no boot binding exists yet either, so privileged providers remain deferred.
